name: noisy_street_solo
doc: Solo speaker on a busy sidewalk: traffic ambience and distance drift, but the mic is protected and endpointing holds — the capture degrades gracefully, not catastrophically. One claim arrives split across a sentence boundary + short pause (the rolling window must JOIN split-a + split-b). Proves the pipeline survives realistic-but-survivable street noise: full recall, the split claim reassembled, science_health airs, non-allowlist categories HELD (category-hold), opinions dropped.

finals.text: Flamingos are born gray and turn pink from the shrimp they eat.
Honestly this is the best walking route in the whole neighborhood.
Here is a number for you. The US economy is around thirty trillion dollars a year.
Mount Everest grows about four millimeters every single year.
Lightning never strikes the same place twice, that is just physics.
